choices.label: Aura of Cannibalism: the caster's temporary hit points

Aura of Cannibalism.descriptionOnly: +1 with 5 temporary hit points, +2 with 15; its temporary hit points, the damage it deals (10 + caster level at most), and the 1d4 damage are told here

Blood in the Water.descriptionOnly: on the sharks and blood-frenzied creatures in its area; the caster's 1 point of bleed damage is told here

Bouncy Body.descriptionOnly: falls count 20 feet shorter; the Acrobatics check to bounce is told here

Endothermic Touch.descriptionOnly: the target is also staggered and holds its breath twice as long, told here

Fleshy Facade.descriptionOnly: only an intelligent undead's; the save to detect it and its damage as one size smaller are told here

choices.label: Gift of the Deep: the benefit

Gift of the Deep.descriptionOnly: the prehistoric form is Large, as enlarge person; the four-armed claws (1d4), the extra feats, the blindness and the spines' 1d4 damage are told here

Hungry Earth.descriptionOnly: no path: the earth's CMB (5 + caster level, +5 against a creature it already grapples) and the DC 20 and 25 to escape are its own

Ice Slick.descriptionOnly: no path: its numbers are its damage or healing, DCs and saves against it, rolled at the table

Ironskin.descriptionOnly: +4, one more for every four caster levels above 4th, +7 at most at 15th level (so counted from 3rd, as its maximum says)

Magic Boulder.descriptionOnly: no path: the boulders' +1 on attack and damage rolls is their own, as magic stone's

Mark of the Reptile God.descriptionOnly: only while the handprint glows, within 60 feet of the caster; its 1d6 acid damage and the daily 1d4 Charisma damage are told here

Mud Buddy.descriptionOnly: no path: the mud buddy's AC 12, 10 hit points, Strength 5, speeds and CMB are its own

Scale Spikes.descriptionOnly: no path: the spikes are +1 armor spikes, a weapon of their own
